note: The weights are my own judgement, not fitted to data. Each score is the weighted mean of the p_<input> percentiles that exist for a player; missing inputs are skipped, not counted as zero. main = the archetype Score shown throughout the site (its weights are the sliders); raw = 2025 Results and und = 2025 Skills, compared on the player page, where the gap is Skills minus Results. 2025 Results uses rates, never counting stats, so the gap isn't driven by playing time. Speed and Volatility have only a Score.

reliability.note: Weights for the 0-100 reliability score. The formulas are in data-pipeline/README.md.
